paragraphs: R' Yose, his son, a Tanna of a baraita. Megillah 7a.[^1]

notes.text: Yose’s abbreviated title is retained as R', restoring the older neutral R. His son is contextual to the Dormaskit heading, though the body names no father and no identity is independently bound. Tanna of a baraita remains explicit; 7a is conventional, without a named matching edition.
